item.title: Nodex 0.5.8
item.description:
### Added - Use Nodex in Simplified Chinese. **Settings > General > Language** follows your system language by default, or you can choose English or 简体中文. Open windows and menus switch at once, without a restart, and dialogs and notifications follow. Your Pages, chats and Agent replies stay in the language they were written in. - Use DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM or MiniMax with your own API key. Paste a key in setup or **Settings > Agents > API keys** and Nodex checks it, lists the provider's models and runs them on its built-in Claude Code, so there is nothing to install. Any other Anthropic-compatible endpoint, such as your team's gateway, works too. Keys are stored encrypted with your system keychain and are never shown again. - Nodex finds Google Antigravity on your computer and connects it in one click. If Antigravity's `agy` command line is installed, setup and **Settings > Agents > Other agents** offer it with its version, and connecting it keeps your existing Google sign-in and models.
### Fixed - Nodex waits for a chat and its delegated work to finish before offering Accept. Only the chat's root Agent can report the Page ready, and a later round reopens the work unless you have since changed its Status.
- Chats with agents added through the Agent Client Protocol get a real title. They used to keep their whole opening prompt as the title; Nodex now uses the name the agent gives its own session, unless you chose a title model in Settings or renamed the chat first.
- Google Antigravity can answer in Nodex. Every message to it used to fail before it could start, because it couldn’t read the format of one of Nodex’s tools; Nodex now describes its tools in a form every Agent accepts.
